previous.review_surface: Original returned pixels actually inspected through white and black alpha composites; raw file retained unchanged.
previous.observation: Root actually inspected current white and black QA and all six exact prepared references including original2589. The canonical full-body pose retains asymmetric upturned palms, differing shoe tilt, complete ankle-strap shoes, source cuffs/bow/apron/waist, round monochrome source eyes and shallow closed smile. Low anatomical LEFT beads remain viewer RIGHT partly bob-occluded, with broad gray fronts, small diagonal returns, taper C at shoulder/chest. No visible P1; narrow mechanical returns, slight soft gray shading and thin mint edging remain P2. First1110 camera crop and dynamics are not certified by this static decision.
